prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 33 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1076; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Treatment summary: The patient presented with neck strain following a low-speed head-on collision. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type. Over the course of care the patient attended 33 visits, a volume well above what is usually needed for this injury, with near-daily sessions for much of the treatment period. Additional body regions were added several weeks after the collision. Imaging and standard examination tests were within normal limits, and nearly all documented findings rest on the patient's own pain reports. The history includes a small strain in the same area years earlier, which healed fully. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same service. Ongoing care decisions should be reviewed against these findings.
